notes.title: Join our Discord server and be ready for the release!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are happy to announce our Discord server where we will share updates about the game's progress!

It is the best place to provide feedback, requests or just share discoveries with other people stuck in the pyramid.

So what are you waiting for? Join our awesome community! :D

[url=https://discord.gg/rpTAu3W]Lumina Discord Server[/url]
